gloss: to restrain; to suppress; to control

definitions.gloss: to restrain; to suppress; to control; to curb
definitions.explanation: To hold back, limit, or keep something in check. Used for controlling emotions, growth, spending, inflammation, and other things that might otherwise increase or spread.

examples.japanese: {感情|かんじょう}を{抑制|よくせい}する。
{政府|せいふ}は{物価|ぶっか}の{上昇|じょうしょう}を{抑制|よくせい}しようとしている。
examples.english: The government is trying to curb rising prices.

examples.japanese: この{薬|くすり}はがん{細胞|さいぼう}の{増殖|ぞうしょく}を{抑制|よくせい}する{効果|こうか}があると{報告|ほうこく}されている。
examples.english: This medicine has been reported to have the effect of suppressing the growth of cancer cells.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used in academic, medical, political, and technical contexts. Implies actively holding something back that would otherwise grow or intensify. The noun form {抑制|よくせい} is also commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感情|かんじょう}を{抑制|よくせい}する (to restrain emotions)
- {物価|ぶっか}を{抑制|よくせい}する (to curb prices)
- {増殖|ぞうしょく}を{抑制|よくせい}する (to suppress growth)
- {抑制|よくせい}{効果|こうか} (suppressive effect)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {抑|おさ}える: to hold down, to suppress — more everyday, broader usage
- {制限|せいげん}する: to restrict, to limit — focuses on setting limits
- {阻止|そし}する: to prevent, to block — stronger, implies completely stopping
